header.title: P.Oxy. 88 5654: Magical Formulary with Hymns: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Greek magical papyri and amulets
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:1000529:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY 4.0: credit papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (the source's own licence is CC BY 3.0) and this AI translation.

notes.1.3: A fragment. The restorations across line breaks are the edition's: μαγευ-[μάτων], 'sorceries' (1.5–6), and ὀρ-[γήν], 'anger' (1.7–8). The verb in 1.4 (κικλησκε..) has lost its ending. σθένει (1.6) may be 'with might' or 'is mighty over'. The word ends -ou, -titōn and -ys cannot be identified. Asterisks are as printed.
